Clara (PM): Handoff: we need a compact DP invite + SLAs so Sales stops DMing.
Omar (ProdOps): What are the absolute must-capture fields?
Clara (PM): Use-case (1 sentence), sessions (3x30m), infra preference (hosted/dedicated/private), qps & tokens estimate, screener link, NDA, stipend. 
Leah (Eng): Add region & required hardware (GPU type) if they pick dedicated.
Ibrahim (Sales): Also a quick checkbox: can demo in <2w? Helps prioritize.
Nadia (Legal): Include a short data-handling blurb: "we retain ephemeral logs only; opt-out available". Flag on-prem/HSM for SOW review.
Omar (ProdOps): Draft invite (short): ```Hi {name}, Redwood is running a private test of inference latency/cost for real flows. Commitment: ~3 sessions (30m) over 4-6 weeks. Tell us: one-line use case, qps & tokens/request, infra preference, demo window. Screener: https://go.redwood/dp-screener NDA: https://go.redwood/nda Stipend: $350. Reply to accept or ask Qs.```
Leah (Eng): SLA: ProdOps ack <24h, Eng triage for infra blockers <48h, PM scope decision <72h, escalate Dedicated within 12h for dedicated requests.
